items.headline: Anthropic releases Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2
items.caption: Its newest top models, with better coding, reasoning and vision.
body: Fable 5.2 drops to $8 per million input tokens and is about 30% faster.
It now supports zero data retention for business clients.

items.headline: André 3000 scored his own Moncler campaign
items.caption: He's the latest star in Moncler's Re/Icons 2026 series.
body: It follows ads with Cher, Grace Jones and JENNIE.
Re/Icons now includes a full ready-to-wear line.
How to wear it: a bold puffer over simple layers.

items.headline: Nike's tough Cordura P-6000 in 'Anthracite'
items.caption: A quiet black dad shoe that repels water.
body: Cordura gives military-grade toughness.
It looks rugged but stays simple.
How to wear it: with black jeans and a field jacket.

items.headline: adidas turned the Campus into a cosy winter boot
items.caption: The Campus 00s Winter goes laceless and fluffy.
body: It keeps the chunky skate-shoe shape.
It looks a lot like an UGG.
How to wear it: with joggers on cold weekends.

items.headline: Vans made the Slip-On into a puffer snow boot
items.caption: The Mid-Slip Puff has padded uppers and a fur collar.
body: All-Trac soles grip icy streets.
It's the classic slip-on, winterised.
How to wear it: with cargo pants and thick socks.

items.headline: Jamie Campbell Bower's real-life wardrobe
items.caption: He only wears suits if they're McQueen.
body: The Stranger Things actor talks about his rock-star style icons.
He's heading to The Rings of Power next.
Style lesson: if you wear a suit, make it count.

items.headline: The basics Jeremy Allen White and Harry Styles love
items.caption: They come from womenswear brand Leset.
body: White wore Leset's layered long-sleeve tee.
GQ says sizes may now be hard to find.
How to wear it: a simple layered tee and straight jeans.

items.headline: 15 affordable coats that look expensive
items.caption: Esquire's pick of outerwear that won't break your budget.
body: Great coats make great screen style, from Casablanca to The Matrix.
These look pricier than they are.
How to wear it: a dark wool coat over everything.

items.headline: King Charles' all-year sunglasses
items.caption: The King keeps wearing the same American-made shades.
body: Esquire says he likes what he likes.
His favourites come from brand Serengeti.
Style lesson: find one great pair and stick with it.

items.headline: Ming's 'Halo' rethinks the dress watch
items.caption: A stripped-down 51.01 in crystallised titanium.
body: It's a new material and case for Ming.
Hodinkee calls it a dramatic departure.
Style lesson: a dress watch should be slim and quiet.

items.headline: Awake adds lacquer-art 'Silver Leaf' watches
items.caption: Three new colours plus a 200-piece limited edition.
body: The Sơn Mài dials are a Métiers d'Art lacquer craft.
Colours: Java Green, Gentian Blue, Indian Red and Purple Viola.
Style lesson: let the dial be the jewellery.

items.headline: A dredging ban brought sea life back to the Summer Isles
items.caption: Protected pink seaweed now shelters fish, whales and dolphins.
body: Locals pushed for the ban on scallop dredging 10 years ago.
Residents call it the best thing to happen to the islands.

items.headline: Glowworms return after 100 years, thanks to a garden shed
items.caption: Volunteer Peter Cooper breeds glowworms and releases the larvae.
body: They're back in a North Yorkshire reserve.
The reserve's manager credits his passion.

items.headline: Halloween skeletons cheered a woman through cancer treatment
items.caption: A yard of posed skeletons brightened her weekly drive.
body: The homeowner had received hate mail for his hobby.
Tammy Wyche loved the creativity on her way to treatment.
